Round 142 failed C on one Medium bug, so round 143 is a small fix for it. The decision is **CONTINUE** (D-29z108); the task is written and nothing in the app source was changed.

**What C found in round 142**
- Every browser check passed at 1440×900 and 1280×720, except the layout check.
- The checks that passed include the detail panel texts and statuses, the library labels, the Georgian count (none left outside the expected exceptions) and the purchase protection. In real audio, Clip Gain −20 dB dropped the level by 20.0 dB and reset brought it back within 0.03 dB.
- **C-R142-01 (Medium):** at 1440, with a video clip selected, the new English Clip Gain reason wraps to 2 lines (it was 1) and pushes the video placeholder sideways. C swapped the Georgian text back into the same page and the problem disappeared, so the English text is the cause.
- The root gate for round 142 was skipped. Round 142's code (22 files) stays uncommitted on top of commit `6e9f9b1`; rounds 142 and 143 will be published together after C passes round 143.

**Round 143 task**
- **The fix:** the reason becomes `A video clip has no Clip Gain — use the track Volume/Mute`. A measured it at 1 line, 329 px wide; the Georgian text it replaced was 327 px. It only drops "for its sound" and needs no class change.
- **Pins:** A updates the literal in 5 test files and in the strings test.
- **Small extra fix:** the polish test still had two titles saying "in Georgian" and a check (`'end, წმ'`) that could never fail. The titles are corrected and the check becomes a real guard against the old seconds unit coming back.
- **A's own browser check is now required.** At 1440 the reason must be 1 line and the placeholder must be within 1 px of its old position. If not, A stops and I choose between accepting the shift and using the 333 px alternative before C runs.
- **Mutation tests:** m88 restores the old text and must fail the pinned tests. m89 and m90 must fail on the new guard line itself, otherwise A does not claim the guard works.
- **C's checks:** the exact text and tooltip in both video states at both sizes, and the layout. At 1440 the layout is compared with my earlier baseline. At 1280 it is compared with C's own round-142 measurement and only has to be "no worse", because the clipping there existed before round 142. C also re-checks one sample each of the neighbouring features, including one real-audio measurement, and the purchase protection.

**Backlog updates (only from C's evidence)**
- V-0.4e is marked **ბაგია** (bug), not done.
- The two round-141 gate items C confirmed (exact test count, doc 117 status) are closed.
- C's two Lows go to `deferred_low_polish`, now 201 entries. The first is that searching `stems` returns nothing. The second is text clipped at the bottom of the open detail panel at 1280, which C showed was already there.
- A's seven round-142 deviations are approved.

**I corrected three errors in my round-142 task:**
- I said `stems` would match stem sounds in the library search. It cannot, because the label it searches is `Stem`.
- I called a toggle label a folder toggle; it belongs to the collection.
- My 1280 "collapsed" baseline was really the open panel.

The reviewer's note that the library search reads the display labels becomes a requirement for V-0.5 (separate search words, including plurals). It is also added to my open architecture checkpoint request to root, which I repeated because V-0.4 ends with this round.

**Next round:** the regression round is due on or after 2026-10-27; it is 2026-10-24, so round 144 is either that or V-0.5 depending on when it is planned. There are no answers yet from Saba on the Ableton or design reviews.

**Why not COMPLETE or BLOCKED:** V-0.4e, V-0.5, the rest of VISUAL-A, T12-ADVANCED, the 201 deferred Lows, the Tech Lead manual checks, SRW-21 and the checks that need the backend are all still open. Nothing external is missing, so it is not BLOCKED.

The advisor was available and I used it twice. The second call added the required browser check for A and the guard-only mutations.
